item.title: Housing Auto Pricing (Part 3) - Neural Network
item.description: Data scraping and preprocessing are done. Now, I’ll use a simple BP neural network to fit the data. I’m using TensorFlow 2.1.0. Input/Output Selection Since we’re just testing the BP neural network, let’s keep inputs and outputs simple. INPUT: place_id, house_type, house_area, house_towards OUTPUT: house_price The four input data are: Area ID (I’ve numbered each area, e.g., Andingmen: 1) House type (also numbered, e.g., Board-style: 0) House area (in square meters) House direction/towards (also numbered, e.
